stored_roi_construction.3m_1m_legs: same rule per leg where the export has the forecast price present, the ROI blank and the leg's sheet_tuple_conflict tag; legs with a published ROI keep the exported value; legs blank without a conflict tag stay blank.
stored_roi_construction.C1_noise: export publishes the leg BLANK (withheld by core/sheet_presentation.py). The withheld stored fraction is reconstructed by the interval rule: stored = round(implied + sign * delta, 6) with delta = (pres_tol + noise_bound)/2 when noise_bound > pres_tol + 1e-6 (the 4-dp price noise can exceed the presenter tolerance -> 'round' class), else pres_tol + 2e-6 ('drift' class). noise_bound = 0.00005/cp + 5e-7; pres_tol = max(5e-6, |implied|*1e-6). Any value in (pres_tol, noise_bound] is indistinguishable to the seam from the real withheld value, so the release count equals the class count by construction. The challenge's literal 0.6*noise_bound lands INSIDE the presenter's acceptance band for cp > ~5.8 (8150.SR cp 6.7: 4.8e-6 <= 5e-6 -> published, not withheld), so the midpoint is used instead.
stored_roi_construction.C2_precision_limited: stored = reason-text roi<h>=X.X%/100 (the only export witness) when it disagrees with implied beyond pres_tol, else the interval rule.
stored_roi_construction.C4_ceiling, C5_fixo_control, C8_coherent: exported values verbatim (C6: ROI left blank, no conflict tag).
stored_roi_construction.C7_f7class: stored = reason-text percent / 100 (reason disagrees with FP/CP-1 beyond fct_tol or beyond noise + 0.0005).

meta.target_mean_price: copied from the exported Target Price column (engine key target_price) so the provider-target rows carry the analyst target the LKG store would have planted.
meta.warnings_rule: Warnings reduced to WITNESS parts kept verbatim: parts starting with analyst_lkg:, provider_target, eq_roi_backfill:, fctuple_, f7_settle, acquisition_status:, fund_unit_contract:, fund_coherence_repaired:, margin_publish:, display_pair_synced, intrinsic_soft_ceiling_applied, analyst_trend_block_applied, identity_quarantined, crypto_pair_shape, roi_unit_, r12_ceiling:, tuple_noise:, scoring_settlement, dq_capped:, quote_current_price_missing, confidence_default_suspected plus any part containing one of cap, forecast, target, roi, drop, reject, provider_target, price_bar_stale, xprovider_price_conflict (the investability gate's reliability-penalty substrings). Provenance/plumbing parts (quote_*_from_suffix, name_from_chart_meta, fund_cache:*, acquisition_acquired_at:*, ...) are dropped for size. The presenter's own receipts (sheet_*: outputs of present_instrument_row, never present on an engine row at the first-presentation site) are excluded from the INPUT warnings; the builder reads them for the cohort classification only.
